title: Optimal Context Mapping (Model D): a shared, learning retrieval layer for AI coding agents
description: Optimal Context Mapping scans a team's repositories once into a workspace of meaning fingerprints. It ranks the code and docs an AI agent should read first for a question, and it learns from every answered question, so the same research is not paid for twice. It ships as a Python package with hooks for Claude Code and MCP tools for other agents. Version 0.2.1. Reproducible benchmarks against Graphify: https://github.com/devkancheti4-design/model-d-graphify
